_deal: The board's test node, until he plays it.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-11-12 'yeah add it to pre 19th, I dont want players to "lose" mission types by upgrading' and 'yeah start' (one of every type by the 19th); OT-24's board beat, played 14:17
_note: BOARDING, LOOK 3 OF 3: the true derelict (old remote qst14 'Recovery', 6 quests): disabled, dark (lights at 20%), a creature crew, an item to find.
THE PLAYER'S PART: going into the dark, and finding the log among whatever moved in.

Register: quiet, a family's grief kept short. The sister does not say what she fears, and the close does not read the log aloud. A cargo hull (the hail probe's) as the freighter; his or Kim's pick if another reads more like a home.

FRANCES (rework) and KIERAN (rework) 2026-11-12: she cannot see 'his writing' over the radio, so the close is 'You've got it. I'll read it later, on my own.'; 'I'm glad it was you that went in' cut (unearned); the journal no longer walks the log out to her. Frances's pick YES: a creature crew is placed aboard (aboard.crew), so the dread stands. Kieran's pick: the log is a marked pickup deep in the ship (the board beat as built), not handed over on boarding.

2026-11-12, his: the sister must not know something is living aboard. Card, briefing and call no longer say it; the player finds out by boarding, and only the closing record names it. A revoice of the call.

prose.name: Recovery: The Quiet Freighter over <Planet>
prose.briefing: A freighter has been drifting dark over <Planet> for weeks. The captain's sister wants his log brought out.
prose.card: My brother's freighter has been dark over <Planet> for weeks and nobody answers. Bring me his log, please.

broadcast: She's been dark for weeks and nobody's answered. If he left anything, it'll be in his log. Mind yourself in there.

beats.journal: A freighter had drifted dark over <Planet> for weeks. I boarded her, got past what was living aboard, and found the captain's log for his sister.
say: You've got it. I'll read it later, on my own.
